card.name: Words right before catching a disease
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'also', 'however', 'they', 'when' or 'of' placed just before a verb for catching or getting an infection. The subject is a person or animal, and the text is about how a disease spreads.

modes.label: Adverb before getting disease
modes.description: An adverb like 'however' or 'also' after 'can' and before 'get' or 'suffer from' a disease.
modes.example: They can<< however>> get the disease in other ways as well

modes.label: Subject or 'when' before infection
modes.description: A pronoun or 'when' that comes just before 'got' or 'are infected'.
modes.example: people in this age group developed symptoms when<< they>> got mono

modes.label: Risk of getting infection
modes.description: 'of' in a phrase about the risk of getting an infection.
modes.example: not being circumcised can also increase the risk<< of>> getting HIV infection

card.writes: It promotes forms of 'contract' (as in contracting a disease), so it pushes the next word toward catching or contracting an illness.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the text says someone catches or gets an infection.
